newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Major Drilling wins control of contractor.
newsitem.headline: Major Drilling wins control of contractor.

text.p: Canadian drilling contractor Major Drilling Group International Inc has waived all conditions of its offer for Australia's Mining World Ltd after lifting its holding to 50.04 percent, the two companies said in a joint statement on Thursday.
The directors of Mining World said they strongly recommended shareholders accept Major Drilling's A$0.85 a share offer, and did not believe any other offer was likely to emerge.
The Canadian company, which launched the bid through its Australian subsidiary, has extended the closing date for its offer to July 4 from June 30.
Mining World shares closed steady at A$0.82 on Thursday.
